fields.title: 2026-W42 R&D weekly report / 2026-W42 研发周报
fields.summary: 9 changes merged; coupons and PDF invoices await acceptance; rate limiting is late. / 合并 9 项变更；优惠码和 PDF 发票待验收；接口限流已超期。
fields.body:
**Summary / 结论:** 9 changes merged across 3 products. Coupon codes and PDF invoices are ready for acceptance; rate limiting on the public pricing API is four days late.
本周 3 个产品共合并 9 项变更。优惠码和 PDF 发票已可验收；公共价格接口限流晚了四天。

## Shipped last week / 上周完成

**Lumen App**
- Shoppers can apply a coupon code at checkout — ready for acceptance ([#412](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/412), [#421](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/421)) / 结算页支持优惠码，待验收
- Repeated taps no longer create duplicate orders — accepted on 10-17 ([#418](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/418)) / 连点不再重复下单，已验收
- Payment SDK upgraded to 5.2 ([#409](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/409)) / 支付 SDK 升级到 5.2

**Ledger API**
- Itemised PDF invoices with the company tax ID — ready for acceptance ([#88](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/88), [#90](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/90), [#91](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/91)) / 含明细和税号的 PDF 发票，待验收
- Failed payment webhooks retry for up to 24 hours ([#86](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/86)) / 支付失败回调自动重试

**Atlas Admin**
- Store staff can export orders to CSV — acceptance pending ([#52](https://git.example.com/atlas/atlas-admin/pull/52)) / 订单导出 CSV，待验收

## In progress / 进行中
- Lumen App · Delivery-date estimate on the cart — in review ([#425](https://git.example.com/lumen/lumen-app/pull/425)) / 购物车预计送达日期，评审中
- Lumen App · Saved addresses at checkout — in progress, due 10-30 / 收货地址簿，进行中
- Ledger API · Invoice numbering per legal entity — in review ([#93](https://git.example.com/ledger/ledger-api/pull/93)) / 按法人主体编号，评审中
- Ledger API · Rate-limit the public pricing API — **late, due 10-17** / 公共价格接口限流，**已超期**

## Open needs / 还有什么需求
| Priority / 优先级 | Need / 需求 | Product / 产品 | From / 提出人 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| High / 高 | Apple Pay on web checkout / 网页结算支持 Apple Pay | Lumen App | Sales / 销售 |
| High / 高 | Month-end reconciliation totals do not match / 月末对账金额不一致 | Ledger API | Finance / 财务 |
| High / 高 | Refund request queue for support / 客服退款申请队列 | Atlas Admin | Support / 客服 |
| Medium / 中 | Role permissions for store managers / 门店店长角色权限 | Atlas Admin | Store ops / 门店运营 |

## Risks and decisions / 风险与需要拍板
1. **Checkout revamp is at risk.** Apple Pay has not started and the project is due 11-06. Decide: move Apple Pay out of this project, or move the date. / **结算改版有风险。** Apple Pay 还没开始，项目 11-06 到期。请决定：把 Apple Pay 移出本项目，还是推迟日期。
2. **Rate limiting is late.** It waits on the platform team's gateway change. / **接口限流已超期。** 在等平台组的网关变更。
3. **Three deliveries wait for acceptance:** coupon codes (Mia Zhang), PDF invoices (Finance), CSV export (Ava Liu). / **三项交付待验收：** 优惠码（张米娅）、PDF 发票（财务）、导出 CSV（刘安娃）。

## Coverage / 数据覆盖
Read 9 changelog rows, 18 tasks, 6 deliveries and 4 projects. Every merged pull request in the four repositories has a changelog row. / 读取 9 条变更、18 个任务、6 项交付、4 个项目。四个仓库已合并的 PR 都有变更记录。

## Risks and decisions / 风险与需要拍板
- None this week. / 本周无。
